products.name: Azure AI Content Safety & Responsible-AI Guardrails — Commercial
products.short_description: Put guardrails around your AI apps — Azure AI Content Safety, prompt-shield, groundedness checks, and a responsible-AI review process.
products.description:
Put guardrails around your AI apps — Azure AI Content Safety, prompt-shield, groundedness checks, and a responsible-AI review process.

A custom AI app with no safety layer can emit harmful content, be jailbroken, or hallucinate confidently — a brand and compliance risk. This solution adds guardrails: Azure AI Content Safety (text/image moderation, prompt shields against jailbreak/injection, protected-material and groundedness detection), a blocklist and severity policy, and a responsible-AI review and red-team process integrated into the app lifecycle.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Python, IaC & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Azure AI Content Safety — text/image moderation with severity thresholds
  • Prompt Shields (jailbreak / indirect prompt-injection) and blocklists
  • Groundedness detection and protected-material checks
  • Integration pattern (pre/post-generation filtering) for your AI apps
  • Responsible-AI review, red-team prompts, and an incident/appeal process

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

AI apps with real guardrails — harmful content blocked, jailbreaks shielded, groundedness checked, and a responsible-AI process behind it.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AISAFETY-Blocklist.py — safe manager for the custom Content Safety blocklist (preview by default)
    • AISAFETY-Discovery.py — read-only inventory of custom AI apps and their current safety posture
    • AISAFETY-Report.py — read-only moderation-posture report over the red-team and benign prompt sets
    • AISAFETY-SafetyFilter.py — the reusable pre/post-generation guardrail for your AI apps
    • AISAFETY-Validate.py — read-only check that the guardrail configuration is correctly wired

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
